qemu_cmdline: qemu-system-aarch64 -machine virt,gic-version=3 -cpu host -enable-kvm -smp 2 -m 1G -drive file=/home/<user>/output/disk-qemu,if=none,id=drv0,format=raw -device virtio-blk-device,drive=drv0 -snapshot -netdev tap,id=n0,ifname=tap-qnx,script=no,downscript=no -device virtio-net-device,netdev=n0,mac=52:54:00:11:11:11 -object rng-random,filename=/dev/urandom,id=rng0 -device virtio-rng-device,rng=rng0 -kernel /home/<user>/output/ifs-demo2.bin -nographic
load_policy: started, verified alive after 3 s and at probe end, stopped at probe end; ceiling 17s
order: Williams over the loaded arms (period 2: gpu,cpu / cpu,gpu); idle first and idle2 last every round
